blocks.en:
---
name: principle-guard-the-context-window
description: "Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads."
disable-model-invocation: true
---
blocks.zh:
---
name: principle-guard-the-context-window
description: "大量输出、长文件、重复读取、并行分工规划使上下文吃紧时应用。大批内容交给 subagent，主线程只保留摘要，不放原始载荷。"
disable-model-invocation: true
---

blocks.en: **Why:** Context overflow degrades reasoning quality, creates compression artifacts, and halts progress.
blocks.zh: **原因：** 上下文溢出会降低推理质量，造成压缩失真，并中断进展。

blocks.en:
**Pattern:**
- **Size phases and cap scope.** Limit files per phase, set turn budgets, account for mechanism costs.
blocks.zh:
**做法：**
- **划分阶段并限制范围。** 限制每阶段文件数，设定轮次预算，并计入机制本身的成本。
